column1: # The recipes the fleet uses: for an item, the recipe every list of needs follows (craftbook.py needs and build, hive.py
# base, surplus.py reserve and the reserve held against game/reserve.tsv) where the fleet uses another than the rule's.
# Kept by Logistics (rule F24); a row is the recipe our crafters and facilities really run, not a wish.
# Without a row an item follows the rule: the recipe nearest to what is mined, by hand before a facility, then the fewest
# inputs. The rule can name an input the fleet cannot get where another recipe takes ore we hold: choose here.
# Tab-separated; `#` starts a comment. One row per item.
# item: an item id | recipe: the id of a recipe that makes it (all of them with their inputs: craftbook.py item <id>)
# note: who chose it, when, and whether it is flown
# A row whose item or recipe the catalog does not hold, or whose recipe does not make the item, is skipped by every
# answer with a NOTE and fails the gate (`surplus.py check`).
